name: epic-default
description: Default epic (attach on tag 'epic'). DECOMPOSE RUNS FIRST: an epic whose children are written straight from an audit or a request produces bundled slices, and a bundled slice is the shape that put 14 of 19 implementer turns past 80k tokens — the size where every review had to intervene. The planning step exists to cut them: one finding per slice, at most 3 scope paths, no fork left for the implementer to decide. Then gate on the slices, review the epic as a whole, and harvest.

name: tweak
description: Cheap tweak tier for lci-cpp: scope to the edit, then a debug-preset configure+build. Parallelism is bounded by the presets (jobs=4). The compile cache is path-independent (CCACHE_NOHASHDIR/BASEDIR + -ffile-prefix-map, per-file LCI_TESTS_SOURCE_DIR), so a NEWLY CREATED worktree at a never-built path gates in ~45-50s once any prior shipped-mechanism run has warmed the ccache (measured 2026-08-30: 45s and 48s at two randomized mktemp paths, 506/510 hits); truly cold cache is ~20min, so 600s is the backstop for warm runs, not the cold path.
